primaryPremise: The live genius list contains two stale-intelligence maintenance items, but fresh code and release-gate verification found deeper repo-owned defects: an unauthenticated AI vision endpoint plus renewable free/trial model spend, widespread user-visible mojibake, SOUL-conflicting earnings claims, and multiple derived observability surfaces that report stale or wrongly scoped truth.

items.title: Close the AI cost/auth perimeter with lifetime trial ceilings and authenticated vision
items.evidence: The live CANON-029 gate blocks PromoGrind as AUDIT-PENDING and identifies promo-advisor spend. Live code proves a broader issue: trialActive() promotes trial users to closer, several closer limits are Infinity, free promo-advisor resets daily, and parse-bet-slip has verify_jwt=false with no in-function auth or quota.
items.recipe: Extend the shared AI access contract with non-renewing lifetime ceilings for free/trial traffic; retain paid-tier daily/unlimited policy; require authenticated access for parse-bet-slip; cap image payloads and reject remote image URLs; add regression tests that prove hard 429 behavior and no anonymous provider call. Record the project as trial-ceiling in repo truth and ship an Ark request for the Studio-owned registry update.

L1.recipe: Disable the unauthenticated vision endpoint and set finite trial limits.

L2.recipe: Shared lifetime quota semantics, authenticated vision, payload caps, and unit tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus explicit quota metadata, all AI call-site adoption, release-gate evidence, and browser-safe user copy.

items.title: Repair user-visible mojibake and make UTF-8 integrity a permanent release gate
items.evidence: Live grep finds broken UTF-8 sequences across App, onboarding, dashboard, calculators, tracking tools, team accounts, referral copy, and loading states. Existing 549 tests pass because no integrity test scans user-facing source.
items.recipe: Mechanically decode the known double-encoded sequences in tracked app source, review every remaining suspicious byte sequence, add a deterministic source-integrity checker with a tight allowlist for legitimate non-English content, wire it into launch verification, and add regression coverage.

L1.recipe: Repair visible strings in the highest-traffic surfaces.

L2.recipe: Repair all tracked source and add a failing integrity scanner.

L3.recipe: L2 plus launch-gate wiring, fixtures, and source-location diagnostics.

items.title: Turn PromoGrind's SOUL into an executable public-claims contract
items.axis: creative alignment / UX / security and trust
items.evidence: Live source contradicts the calm operator SOUL with phrases including '100% Legal', 'passive profit', 'free money', and deterministic monthly-income language. Static tests do not enforce the anti-goal against gambling-hype copy.
items.recipe: Rewrite risky certainty/hype language into evidence-bound, educational operator language; build a public-copy policy scanner for prohibited certainty, passive-income, and reckless-action patterns; provide narrowly documented exceptions for legal policy text; wire the scanner into launch verification and tests.

L1.recipe: Rewrite the most visible hype claims.

L2.recipe: Repo-wide public-copy review plus deterministic scanner.

L3.recipe: L2 plus launch-gate wiring, evidence-aware copy rules, and regression fixtures.

items.title: Make repo-local Studio intelligence stay repo-local and percentage-correct
items.axis: speed and organization / token reduction / observability
items.evidence: The generated genius cache says projectScoped:false and Founder portfolio scope even inside PromoGrind; SESSION_INTENT_PLAN defaults repo touch to studio-ops; the startup brief renders pctUsed 0.5 as 50%; PROJECT_BRIEF remains an empty template.
items.recipe: Add a public-repo local-project fallback to genius generation, derive intent repo touch from PROJECT_STATUS.slug, treat context-meter pctUsed as percentage units, populate PROJECT_BRIEF from repo truth, and add focused tests for each invariant.

L1.recipe: Fix the percentage conversion and local genius scope.

L2.recipe: L1 plus intent scope and PROJECT_BRIEF truth with tests.

L3.recipe: L2 plus self-validating generated surfaces and stale-input diagnostics.

items.title: Replace hard-coded browser launch claims with a generated source-of-truth mirror
items.evidence: src/launchState.js still reports 380/380 tests while live direct verification passes 549/549. Launch Command Center and studio export consume this hard-coded value, violating CANON-031.
items.recipe: Generate a browser-safe validation mirror from PROJECT_STATUS during prebuild, consume it in launchState instead of literals, validate mirror freshness, and cover the source-of-truth chain in tests and launch smoke.

L1.recipe: Remove the stale count and use count-free wording.

L2.recipe: Generate and consume a browser-safe validation mirror.

L3.recipe: L2 plus freshness gate, test-count invariants, and launch-command-center evidence.

items.title: Refresh live IGNIS and revenue intelligence, then prove doctor freshness
items.evidence: The refreshed Unified Genius List contains exactly two unblocked items: IGNIS re-score overdue by 24 days and REVENUE_SIGNALS.md overdue by 24 days. Doctor confirms both are advisory failures and blockingFailing remains 0.
items.recipe: Run the canonical rescore and revenue-signals commands, verify their real exit codes and timestamps, regenerate the genius list, and require doctor 12/12 rather than refreshing a report without checking its consumers.

L2.recipe: Refresh, regenerate dependent surfaces, and verify doctor.

L3.recipe: L2 plus regression tests for freshness propagation.

Already implemented as buildRiskRadarSummary, combining open-position exposure, bankroll stress, pre-mortem, and twin-battle signals in the dashboard.
Workflow inbox already combines expected profit, expiry, freshness, friction, book availability, history, and confidence decay into ranked execution work.
Dark/light theme state and toggles already exist in usePromoAppShell, App, UserMenu, and ProfilePanel. The remaining need is visual verification, not a missing feature.

honestDeferrals: Desktop/mobile and dark/light screenshot verification could not run: the installed in-app browser Node runtime failed to start, @playwright/cli@latest was trust-blocked, and the pinned package depends on alpha Playwright builds. This is a recorded SKIP, never a pass.
Production auth email, Stripe purchase, friend beta, Brevo forwarding, Studio Ops Supabase capability, and production capture-key proof require real external evidence and remain incomplete.

secondOrderInnovations.premise: The new lifetime ceiling solved spend renewal but left five copied policy objects able to drift independently.
secondOrderInnovations.implementation: One typed server-owned registry now supplies every provider-backed function's feature, tier, daily, free-lifetime, and trial-lifetime contract.

secondOrderInnovations.premise: Call-site tests named a fixed file list, so a future provider function could silently bypass the perimeter.
secondOrderInnovations.implementation: A launch-gated discovery scanner finds every Anthropic function and requires authenticated access, central entitlements, atomic quota reservation, usage events, and pinned SDK imports.

secondOrderInnovations.premise: Full Deno checking exposed a floating npm SDK import and pre-existing shared-client/catch typing defects.
secondOrderInnovations.implementation: The trust-approved Anthropic SDK is pinned to 0.113.0, shared usage typing and unknown-error handling are repaired, and all five provider functions pass Deno type checking.

secondOrderInnovations.premise: Exact-lockfile closeout verification found a DOMPurify advisory and then a newly published React Router advisory wave.
secondOrderInnovations.implementation: DOMPurify 3.4.12 and React Router 7.18.0 passed package-trust plus registry provenance/integrity checks; npm audit returned zero vulnerabilities and the full 559-test launch gate reran green.
